reviews.comment: Dr. Ezell is great! A lot of class is just discussing the required reading for that day. She very rarely calls on people and relies more on participation. ENGL 303 was made up of 2 "archival exercises" which are easy if you just follow the rubric, and 3 essays. She is very cooperative and gives great feedback on your writing. Super nice lady.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A fine and rather easy class. Ezell is very thorough, experienced and accommodating, but I found lectures to be a snooze (liked a lot of readings tho). She is also strict about attendance so don't get into a habit of skipping! Also the amount of reading is normal and standard for an ENGL class, so idk what these other ppl are talking about lol.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's an incredibly gifted teacher. She is hilarious, personable, and is clearly passionate about English. She will help you improve your critical thinking and writing skills. Listen to her annotations - it's tough love, it hurts, but she knows what she's doing. Please take her if you really want to improve your writing. Best. Professor. Ever.

Favorite professor/class ever. Not an easy A necessarily, people who didn't want to bother reading didn't do very well, but if you do the work she's fair. Amazing lecturer, hugely enjoyed her class. Don't miss it.

If you read the historical documents (16th--20thc)and go to lecture, this course is a breeze. For her blue book exams you only have to be able to define and write about terms/ themes that occur in multiple readings throughout the unit (very simple to do, and she graded very kindly). Lecture & enjoyable readings, occasionally long, but interesting!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Even for a literature class, the amount of daily readings is ridiculous. The exams are entirely blue book and the t.a. grades them hard. The course description should have specified that all the readings are from the 16/17/18th century. Incredibly boring. Luckily, she grades the online essays easily.

I took Ezell's Women's Writers class in hopes that she would live up to her good reviews on ratemyprofessor. But the amount of daily reading she gave is unnecessary and exhausting. The lectures are not interesting and contain too much information. The exams and essays are vague yet graded very difficulty. DO NOT take this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this class unless you have an absolute passion for reading and/or only taking a few other classes. The amount of reading is ridiculous and you have to remember the tiniest of details. Forget a term or two or can't think of an example?Fail the exam!! The exams are entirely blue book (free-response) and graded by the TA who grades hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Wonderful professor! You do need to read but the material is interesting and the lectures are great! Show up for class. She is a lot of fun and truly cares if you are learning. Get ready for Harry Potter refrences

Dr. Ezell-Mainzer's Shakespeare class was by far my favorite class I have ever taken at TAMU. If you love Shakespeare, I wouldn't pick a different professor. If you don't like Shakespeare, she'll help you understand and analyze tons of different things about his plays. Two tests, a few papers, and plenty of extra credit opportunities. Great class!

Class was entertaining and productive. Everythings easy so long as you keep up with the reading, which isnt too bad. There were 2 essays, 2 exams, and a group project. Also, extra credit to make up 2% of your overall grade. She really cares about her students and has a fabulous sense of humor. Highly recommend taking her if you get the chance.

She is very thorough and knowledgeable about the subject. She gave very clear grading guidelines and graded with respect and good feedback. You move through plays fast, but the reading is definitely manageable if you keep ahead of it. Definitely take her if you can, very enjoyable class. She makes Shakespeare very entertaining.

Dr. Ezell is a very caring and accessible professor. Her office hours are very helpful so definitely take advantage! There is lots of reading to do, so be prepared for that. 3 online writing assignments, where she counts two and drops your lowest grade! There is also extra credit available. Overall a great professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I took her this past semester and if you go to office hours before the exams she is most likely to help you/ give you a hint what the test is going to be about

Theirs not many English professors that truly help you enjoy coming to class, but Professor Ezell is one of the most caring professors I've ever had. Shes hilarious and made the material completely understandable. She never goes over the top with work, and if you just follow along with the class and lecture its an easy A.

This is by far the best professor I've ever had. She is an amazing lecturer, and an all around amazing woman. If you have the chance to take this prof, PLEASE do because you will not regret it. The only homework is three papers throughout the semester and reading the required anthologies.

Class is lecture oriented and consists of 2 tests and 2 papers. I took Dr. Ezell's class on classical mythology and it was very interesting  and she is clearly passionate about what she teaches. Tests are short answer and essay  and somewhat easy if you study the readings and lectures.  Papers are 5 pages and graded fairly. Overall, great professor

She is a very kind lady who is easy to talk to, she isn't the toughest grader but she knows when you tried and is very understanding! Her lectures are engaging but you really need to read before class. One would think the subject would be boring but she makes it interesting and enjoyable. 2 short essays 2 tests and 1 long essay. Fully recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Ezell is wonderful! Take her if you get the chance. Her exams are very easy but you must show up to lecture. Once you have gotten familiar with her grading criteria, you will certainly do well.

This professor is very helpful, she makes the class fun by making jokes and interacts with the students often - very big on asking the class questions. She explains the material thoroughly, but I strongly recommend that you still read most of the material. She gives a lot of extra credit opportunities - easy B, I'd say.
